hooks.command: bash -c 'f="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; if [[ "$f" == *.rs ]]; then cargo fmt --all --check 2>&1 | head -20; fi'
bash -c 'f="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; if [[ "$f" == *.svelte || ("$f" == */daemon/web/*.ts && "$f" != *.d.ts) ]]; then npm run check -w daemon/web 2>&1 | tail -20; fi'
bash -c 'if [[ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" == *Cargo.lock ]]; then echo "BLOCK: Do not edit Cargo.lock directly. Use: cargo update -p <crate> --precise <version>"; exit 2; fi'
